title: HLA: Hadamard Linear Attention
abstract: arXiv:2602.12128v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The attention mechanism is an important reason for the success of transformers. It relies on computing pairwise relations between tokens. To reduce the high computational cost of standard quadratic attention, linear attention has been proposed as an efficient approximation. It employs kernel functions that are applied independently to the inputs before the pairwise similarities are calculated. That allows for an efficient computational procedure which, however, amounts to a low-degree rational function approximating softmax.   We propose Hadamard Linear Attention (HLA). Unlike previous works on linear attention, the nonlinearity in HLA is not applied separately to queries and keys, but, analogously to standard softmax attention, after the pairwise similarities have been computed. translated_title: HLA：阿达马线性注意力（Hadamard Linear Attention）
translated_abstract: 注意力机制是Transformer取得成功的重要原因之一，它依赖于计算token之间的成对关系。为了降低标准二次注意力的高昂计算成本，线性注意力被提出作为一种高效的近似方法。线性注意力采用核函数，在计算成对相似度之前将这些核函数独立地应用于输入，从而实现高效的计算流程，然而这本质上相当于用一个低阶有理函数来近似softmax。我们提出了阿达马线性注意力（HLA）。与以往关于线性注意力的工作不同，HLA中的非线性并非分别作用于查询和键，而是类似于标准softmax注意力，在计算出成对相似度之后再应用非线性。我们将证明，所提出的非线性相当于用一个更高阶的有理函数来近似softmax，并为此提供了高效的计算方案。
tldr: HLA提出了一种新的线性注意力方法，将非线性在成对相似度计算之后（而非分别作用于查询和键）进行施加，相当于用更高阶的有理函数近似softmax，在保持计算高效的同时提升了表达能力。
en_tdlr: HLA introduces a novel linear attention mechanism that applies nonlinearity after computing pairwise similarities rather than separately to queries and keys, amounting to a higher-degree rational function approximation of softmax while maintaining computational efficiency.
